svg.text: Legal Lens — Technical Architecture: End-to-End Flow
v1 · runs fully local · React → FastAPI → LangChain orchestration → advanced RAG · SQLite conversation DB
3 ORCHESTRATION — LangChain (LCEL chains · RunnableBranch by intent)
4 AI LAYER — ingestion pipeline & advanced RAG workflows (all models run locally)
5 DATA & MODELS — everything stays on the lawyer's machine
answers stream in token by token · intent badge: Ask / Summary / Draft
citation chips [p.4 §2.1] open the cited passage in the Source Viewer
drafts get a Copy button · disclaimer: AI-generated content, not legal advice
[ attach file ] Ask, summarize or draft from your documents … [ Send ]
drag & drop PDF / DOCX (digital or scanned)
name · pages · status: Processing → Ready / Failed
event: citation {source, doc_id, page, section, quote}
CORS: localhost only · Request-ID on every call
upload limits: ≤ 25 MB · ≤ 300 pages · PDF / DOCX
ConversationService · ChatService (calls orchestration, relays SSE) · DocumentService (validate, save file, enqueue ingestion)
TransactionLogger — every user action (upload, ask, rename, delete …) is written to the transactions table with its request_id and latency
• last N turns of this conversation
• emits SSE events: intent · token · citation · done
• 'clarify' → asks the user a follow-up question
• persists the turn via ChatService → SQLite
• job state kept in ingestion_jobs table
RAG Workflows — one LangChain chain per intent
all chunks in reading order, grouped by section
local LLM · keeps page / section refs per point
type & purpose · parties · key dates · obligations
Advanced Retrieval — shared by Ask & Draft
magic-byte type check · ≤ 25 MB · ≤ 300 pages · not encrypted · SHA-256 dedupe
reading order · OCR confidence · empty / garbled pages → warnings
strip headers / footers / page numbers · fix hyphenation · page & section map
split on section boundaries · ~500 tokens · 15% overlap
parent–child chunks · metadata {doc_id, page, section, heading path}
child chunks → embedding model → Vector Store
chunk text → BM25 index (SQLite FTS5) · rows → SQLite
status + warnings saved · UI polls GET /api/documents/{id}

ingestion_jobs id · document_id · state · attempts · error

intent router · query editor · answer · summary · draft
